Sets a pixel of a locked buffer to a color given in the form of [WritePixel64](WritePixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and the change shows when it is unlocked. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
Writes the color of a pixel of a locked buffer from four half precision floats (Float16), like [WritePixel64](WritePixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 64, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
LockBuffer
For x = 0 To 255
	WritePixelFast64 x, 10, 0, x / 255.0, 0.25, 0.0, 1.0
Next
UnlockBuffer
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param x       Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y       Vertical position of the pixel.
@param buffer  The locked buffer to write to. Pass 0 for the current buffer.
@param red     The red of the color, as a Float16.
@param green   The green of the color, as a Float16.
@param blue    The blue of the color, as a Float16.
@param alpha   The alpha of the color, as a Float16.
@gap A position outside of the buffer is ignored, and a buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
